crossRefs.note: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
and if children, then heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also…
For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that…
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works…
He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

translations.web: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
translations.bsb: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
translations.kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
translations.asv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.
